news.title: ‘I feel shoehorned’: My father funded my $800,000 Roth IRA. Does that give him the right to say how I invest it?
news.summary: “His argument is essentially that, since my parents provided the money for the Roth, they have a say in how I invest it.”

news.title: My contractor handed my $42,000 pool upgrade to a subcontractor I had already rejected. What can I do?
news.summary: “I specifically rejected Contractor A because of his reputation.”

news.title: Am I too old for Roth conversions? I’m 84 and my wife is 77. We have $8 million saved.
news.summary: “We are reluctant to pay a financial adviser 2% of assets — roughly $160,000 per year.”

news.title: These charts show how leverage-happy investors are transforming the stock market
news.summary: A rush of retail investors and quant funds has caused a shift toward more borrowed money and more short-term trading.

news.title: Party balloons could become a ‘luxury’ as the Iran war spurs a helium shortage
news.summary: Dollar Tree says a helium squeeze has hit sales of balloons and party supplies. Researchers note this could foreshadow higher costs for other industries that depend on the gas.
